# datadog_integration_slack_channels (Data Source)

Use this data source to list the Slack channels configured for a Datadog Slack integration account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "datadog_integration_slack_channels" "example" {
  account_name = "my_slack_account"
}

locals {
  # Names keep the leading "#", matching both the data source output and channel_name.
  wanted_channels = toset(["#alerts-prod", "#alerts-staging"])
}

resource "datadog_integration_slack_channel" "channels" {
  for_each = local.wanted_channels

  account_name = data.datadog_integration_slack_channels.example.account_name
  channel_name = each.key

  display {
    message  = true
    notified = true
    snapshot = false
    tags     = true
  }
}

# Creating a channel already configured in Datadog (for example from the UI) fails, so adopt it instead.
# Importing an address already in state is a no-op, so the block can stay. Requires Terraform 1.7 or later.
import {
  for_each = setintersection(local.wanted_channels, toset(data.datadog_integration_slack_channels.example.channels[*].name))

  to = datadog_integration_slack_channel.channels[each.key]
  id = "${data.datadog_integration_slack_channels.example.account_name}:${each.key}"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_name` (String) Slack account name.

### Read-Only

- `channels` (Attributes List) List of Slack channels configured for the account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--channels))
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--channels"></a>
### Nested Schema for `channels`

Read-Only:

- `display` (Attributes) Configuration options for what is shown in an alert event message. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--channels--display))
- `name` (String) Slack channel name.

<a id="nestedatt--channels--display"></a>
### Nested Schema for `channels.display`

Read-Only:

- `message` (Boolean) Show the main body of the alert event.
- `mute_buttons` (Boolean) Show interactive buttons to mute the alerting monitor.
- `notified` (Boolean) Show the list of @-handles in the alert event.
- `snapshot` (Boolean) Show the alert event's snapshot image.
- `tags` (Boolean) Show the scopes on which the monitor alerted.
